summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. reporting a PDMR share acquisition under EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. The Chief Human Resources Officer purchased 33,760 ordinary shares at $14.8526 per share for an aggregate of $501,423.78. This is a standard insider transaction notification, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The filing is akin to a Form 4 for a US issuer. No action or event beyond the transaction itself is disclosed.
